final: WITH item_quantities AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL) AS quantity FROM Order_Items), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM item_quantities) SELECT iq.order_id, AVG(iq.quantity) AS order_avg_quantity, AVG(iq.quantity) - b.avg_quantity AS difference_from_baseline FROM item_quantities AS iq CROSS JOIN baseline AS b GROUP BY iq.order_id HAVING b.avg_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_baseline DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
